subject: Owner-reported mobile defects on the real devices: Impossible level, theme fit, press-hold preview, app fluidity, and LAN-local private rooms

ios.note: simulator build verified; no install on the device (no Apple signing identity)

defect1_impossible_level.requirement: hide the playable Impossible level; keep the training-data collection / pack engine
removedFromUi: home(): the 'Impossible AI pack' button block
statsView(): the 'Impossible (Local AI)' select option (both selects)
statsView(): the dedicated Impossible stats page and its recent-games ledger
statsView(): the on-device AI record card
a saved statsDifficulty of 'Impossible' is coerced to 'all' so it cannot reach a removed branch
enginePreserved: openNeuralRecovery, LA, MegaAiPack, the aipack handler, MegaApp.startImpossible

tests.browser: tests/bot/pack-browser.py passes with report.playableImpossibleHiddenFromUI=true and the engine exercised through its public APIs

defect2_theme_fit_and_bars.whiteBands_before: status bar rows y=4..114 and nav bar y=2385..2399 were #f7f9fc in every theme
defect2_theme_fit_and_bars.mechanism: window.MegaNativeTheme.apply({theme,dark,surface}); MegaAndroidThemeBridge (WebViewCompat, origin- and entry-scoped, #rrggbb validated) and MegaNativeThemeBridge (WKScriptMessageHandler) paint the bars, inset background and icon appearance

topbarOverflow.before: .header-actions right edge 368.4 (paperclub) / 368.7 (afterhours) at 360px; settings button clipped
topbarOverflow.after: 348 (vector/midnight) and 346 (paperclub/afterhours); whole wordmark visible in all four themes

defect2_theme_fit_and_bars.fluidity: router-swapped screens fade+rise 180ms, taps press (theme-matched), the bottom sheet slides; all transform/opacity only and fully inert under Motion, prefers-reduced-motion and forced-colors; the 44px nav controls are deliberately not animated

defect5_press_hold_preview.behaviour: holding a cell ~200ms shows the cell highlight plus (when the Destination-preview setting is on) the destination mini-board highlight and 'This sends your opponent to the centre board.'; it places NO move; a plain tap still moves

duringHold.text: This sends your opponent to the centre board.

defect5_press_hold_preview.bugFoundAndFixed: paint() rebuilds each mini's className every ~900ms poller tick, wiping the highlight mid-hold; paint() now re-asserts the tracked preview cell

defect3_4_lan_local_private_rooms.ownerRequirement: one device hosts the room; anyone on the same Wi-Fi discovers and joins it with no internet
defect3_4_lan_local_private_rooms.built: src/lan/lan-room-store.js (portable rules + guest sessions + idempotency), src/lan/lan-room-http.js (/api/party/* contract, Host gate, CORS), src/lan/lan-host.js (window.MegaLanHost/MegaLanRoom); shell owns socket+discovery via frozen window.MegaLanSocket/MegaLanDiscovery
defect3_4_lan_local_private_rooms.androidBridge: MegaAndroidLanBridge.kt: ServerSocket, HTTP/1.1 parse, 16KiB cap, chunked decode, NsdManager _megaxo-v5._tcp, static serving via WebViewAssetLoader
defect3_4_lan_local_private_rooms.iosBridge: MegaNativeLan.swift: Network.framework NWListener/NWConnection, Bonjour NWBrowser, WKScriptMessageHandlerWithReply, chunked decode; no ATS key added
verifiedCrossDevice: mac -> phone: capabilities, guest session, tokenless discover, create a real room that the phone's own lobby then lists
phone's WebView -> Mac host: clean 837-byte JSON (chunk framing decoded)
phone -> Mac host: guest session + create a room ON the Mac host
mDNS/Bonjour: the phone resolved 'MacBook Room' at http://192.168.0.8:8082
concurrent: 4 simultaneous guest joins all 200, room roster 5/10, two rooms discoverable at once
restart: refused during downtime, 200 with real JSON after relaunch (auto-resume)
bugsFoundByMeasurement: relayed Transfer-Encoding: chunked responses leaked the chunk framing (fixed: decode chunked / honour Content-Length)
static status line was 'HTTP/1.1 0 Status' because AndroidX WebResourceResponse's 3-arg ctor never sets mStatusCode (fixed)
hosting died with the process and never returned (fixed: persisted intent + resume on load)
lan-host.js dropped the handler's CORS headers (fixed)
defect3_4_lan_local_private_rooms.networkPosture: INTERNET + ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE granted in both flavors (LAN host cannot work without them; NsdManager refuses to run); AD_ID stays removed; usesCleartextTraffic stays false with a loopback-only network_security_config; RFC1918/link-local enforced in code because Android's config has no CIDR syntax

notClaimed: iOS install/run on the physical iPhone (no Apple signing identity)
a two-phone no-internet run (the cross-device proof used this Mac as the second device)
runtime prompt behaviour for NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES on Android 13+
